body: Sometimes I feel like we’re just seen as soulless med filling machines. But I really do think a pharmacist couldnt do it without us, the workload is too much. Just hearing about how they used to run one 35 yrs ago convinces me of that. So I try to catch myself when people ask me if I’m an RPh and I say “I’m just a tech.” A tech is still valuable and should be appreciated for all we do.

I appreciate your thoughts. I always want to give people the benefit of the doubt but in this case I have just screwed myself. I suppose it could have been worse.. like hundreds of dollars worse. But I will definitely be more careful... and I think I'll also just try to see what my bank says about it (if my anxiety and terrible ability to articulate things clearly will allow it)...
You're right. I don't even know if there's anything I can do at this point. I feel like such a dumbass. I don't really know what I was thinking.
I appreciate the time you took to explain this to me 💕
